title: Finding a taxi
passage:
Could you tell me where to catch a taxi?
A. It took about half an hour. B. There's a taxi stand outside the east exit. C. I left my ticket at home.
passageZh:
你可以告訴我在哪裡搭計程車嗎？
A. 大約花了半小時。
B. 東出口外有計程車招呼站。
C. 我把票留在家裡了。
